method: Independent semantic review against glossary blocked_future_concepts, current required facts and prerequisites. A future concept is blocking only when understanding it is necessary, not merely because a name or supplied infrastructure appears. Concept-specific boundaries were applied within multi-concept tiles. Deterministic gates were not rerun; generator reasoning and prior evaluator conclusions were not consulted.

coverage.text_review: Exhaustive over all main and remediation step text, titles, ledes, nested visual/code text, captions, diagram labels, media summaries and bridges, and up-next text.
coverage.interaction_selection: All 17 choice prompts/options plus 8 targeted code tasks, exceeding the approximately one-third sampling target. Sampled task prompts, relevant editable code and constraints were reviewed; supplied harness internals are not learner prerequisites.

tile_reviews.assessment: Model binding, conversion and path/query/body separation stay in scope. The next-concept title is a passing mention; the supplied HTTP harness need not be understood to edit the signature.

Request/function cleanup timing is explicitly a required fact of yield_dependencies, not leakage into dependency_lifetime. Exception visibility and finally cleanup require no later error-envelope concepts.
Named fields, reserved attributes and formatter preservation stay within structured_service_logs; no redaction, correlation or metrics mechanism is needed.
Allowlisting, connected-address validation and redirect checking are current required facts. No later webhook or retry mechanism is required.
Multipart limits, validation and file cleanup stay in scope. Lab rejection status codes do not require understanding later request-validation error structures or error translation.
The access-control distinction is an explicit current fact. No authentication or authorization implementation is required.

Request-local reuse is taught before its checks. Endpoint integration testing is separately taught in s06-s09 before its own interaction; it is not required to follow the earlier dependency-reuse text or sampled task.

Presence/null/default semantics precede the separate OpenAPI lesson. No OpenAPI understanding is needed for the presence section. Following schema references is an explicit current fact, not later contract inspection.
Host matching and www redirection require no proxy-header trust or authentication knowledge. The registered table is a self-contained authored policy comparison.
Synthetic message/context masking remains within log_redaction. Tokens and connection strings are sensitive example values, not mechanisms the learner must understand.
Session ownership and context cleanup stay within async_session_lifecycle; no database CRUD, transaction or query knowledge is needed.

Shutdown verification precedes the separately taught probe contracts. No readiness understanding is needed in the shutdown section. Probe YAML nesting is explicitly explained; no later rollout or diagnosis knowledge is required.

summary: No needs-to-understand leakage found in exhaustively reviewed lesson text or sampled interactions. Up-next concept names are passing mentions and do not constitute defects. This is a leakage verdict, not a final factual or structural audit.
